changes.name: WaterfallProgression
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local map=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap")
local portal=map:WaitForChild("WaterfallPortal")
local prompt=portal:WaitForChild("TravelPrompt")
local destination=map:WaitForChild("WaterfallIsles"):WaitForChild("IslandTop")

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
 local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
 if not coins then return end
 if player:GetAttribute("WaterfallUnlocked")~=true then
  if coins.Value<50 then
   prompt.ObjectText="NEED "..tostring(50-coins.Value).." MORE SKY COINS"
   task.delay(2,function() if prompt.Parent then prompt.ObjectText="WATERFALL ISLES" end end)
   return
  end
  coins.Value-=50
  player:SetAttribute("WaterfallUnlocked",true)
 end
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if root then root.CFrame=CFrame.new(destination.Position+Vector3.new(0,7,0)) end
end)
